mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows the model to invent tasks with zero or multiple owners, violating the core ownership invariant that FR-009 requires.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MultipleOwners { some disj t: Task, u1, u2: User | t.owner = u1 and t.owner = u2 and u1 != u2 }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows tasks to exist without a 'created' audit entry, violating FR-015's requirement that every task mutation produces an audit entry starting with creation.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NoCreatedAudit { some t: Task | no ae: AuditEntry | ae.task = t and ae.operation = Created }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows audit entries to lose their immutability constraint, enabling updates/deletes that FR-017 forbids.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MutableAudit { some ae: AuditEntry | (ae.operation = Created and ae.operation = Edited) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows cross-team users to be owners or sharees of tasks, violating absolute cross-team isolation (FR-006, FR-014).
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CrossTeamShare { some u: User, t: Task | u.team != t.team and (u = t.owner or u in t.sharedWith) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows out-of-team users to appear in shared_with, violating FR-012's same-team requirement.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CrossTeamShare { some t: Task, u: t.sharedWith | u.team != t.team }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows non-owners (sharees or others) to appear in shared_with, violating Q1=A that only the owner controls the share list.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NonOwnerShare { some t: Task, u: t.sharedWith | u != t.owner and t.owner.team = u.team }
